text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Stack: frozen model with the 14-day correction and spread factor 1.15 (score 5.32). Rows give the number of refits in the year. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Zero: same score as the stack.'
